column3: The King of Hearts: a mild, timid, elderly man with a short grey-white beard, dressed as the king on a playing card: a stiff, flat-fronted court-card robe of crimson and gold patterned with red hearts, trimmed with ermine, under a tall gold crown, which at the trial he wears over a great white judge's wig. He carries a small sceptre and a note-book.

The Queen of Hearts: a heavy-jawed, scowling woman of middle age, fair, with dark hair drawn neatly under a small gold crown, dressed as the queen on a playing card: a stiff, flat-fronted court-card gown of red, gold and blue patterned with hearts, with a wide stiff collar. She holds a rounded golden sceptre.

The Knave of Hearts: a young man with a bowed, simple face and long fair hair, dressed as the knave on a playing card: a stiff, flat-fronted court-card tunic of red and gold patterned with hearts, and a flat cap. He carries the King's crown on a crimson velvet cushion; at his trial he stands in chains.

the guests: the royal guests, mostly Kings and Queens of the other suits, men and women of varied ages dressed as the kings and queens on playing cards: stiff, flat-fronted court-card robes in red, black and gold patterned with hearts, diamonds, clubs and spades, trimmed with ermine, and small gold crowns.

the croquet players: the Queen's royal guests, Kings and Queens of the pack, men and women dressed as the kings and queens on playing cards in stiff, flat-fronted court-card robes and small crowns, each holding a live pink flamingo upside down under one arm, its long neck and head swung as the mallet, with live hedgehogs rolled up as the balls.

The Court Crowd: a great crowd of all sorts of little birds and beasts, with animal faces and human posture, some in small waistcoats and bonnets: mice, rabbits, guinea-pigs, ducks, sparrows and owls, packed about the throne together with the whole pack of cards, flat, oblong playing cards with heads, arms and legs at the corners.

The Court Crowd: all sorts of little birds and beasts packed about the throne together with the whole pack of cards. Typical member: a small red squirrel standing upright on its hind legs, with a squirrel's furry face, tufted ears, round dark eyes and a bushy tail, wearing a small green waistcoat and holding its paws together as it watches.
